artworks.title: David's Tomb on Mount Zion, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historical stone structure with Middle Eastern architectural features such as domes and a minaret. The camera angle captures the scene from ground level, slightly angled to the right, offering a wide view of the building. The horizon is low in the image, showing a clear sky. The rugged terrain close to the structure has scattered stones and patches of plants. The color palette is mostly sepia-toned, giving the impression of an old print. Barren hills can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historical cityscape with stone buildings, domes, and towers. The horizon is high in the frame, featuring hilly terrain in the distance. Various domes and minarets stand out among the dense architectural landscape. The buildings are intricately detailed, emphasizing the stonework texture. The color palette is sepia-toned, evoking a sense of age. Closest to the viewer, flat roofs and narrow alleyways are visible, guiding the eye through the city scene.

artworks.title: A Moroccan Woman in Traditional Dress
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of gum arabic, heightened with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: This painting shows a person standing in profile, facing the left. They have long, dark hair that almost entirely obscures their face. They have pale skin and they are wearing an ornate, colorful garment in shades of orange, red, cream, and gray, which has a long skirt that trails behind them. They also have a decorative headpiece on their head, similar to a small cream-colored bonnet. The person holds a round mirror or fan in their left hand and stands next to a wooden couch with a patterned back in shades of yellow, red, blue, and gray, with red cushions. The background is a textured blue-gray wall.

artworks.title: La Décoration et du Feu d'Artifice... la Naissance de Monseigneur le Daufin (Fireworks Celebrating the Birth of the Dauphin)
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner with roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a public celebration with an ornate classical building as the central focus. The scene includes an elevated horizon with statues on columns, a dramatic sky with radiant arcs, and a crowd observing the celebration. The style is detailed etching with a monochromatic sepia color palette, giving a historic feel to the festivities.

artworks.title: Angels in Glory
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink, and brown wash heightened with white on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts celestial beings surrounded by clouds. The figures have wings and are playing various musical instruments or engaged in celestial activities. The scene exudes harmony and a divine presence, enhanced by intricate shading and flowing lines. The artwork is rendered in sepia tones with detailed pen work, giving it a classic and historical feel.

artworks.title: Corso Sant' Anastasia with the Palazzo Maffei in Verona
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink and pen and gray ink, with watercolor and gouache and gum arabic over graphite on thick wove paper (laid on early wove card)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene from an elevated viewpoint, showing a narrow urban passage lined with buildings. A distant sunlit building stands out at the street's end. A blue sky with clouds is visible above the buildings. The painting features detailed architectural elements and uses warm earthy tones with some blue and soft hues. People in period clothing are seen on the street.

artworks.title: The Expulsion from Eden
artworks.medium: cut paper pasted to red-painted wood, the figures and serpent touched with pen and gray ink, graphite, and white gouache
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows intricate, curling lines and spiral shapes on a red background. In the upper left, there are three figures resembling classical sculptures. Two figures are being guided by a winged figure, moving through tree-like motifs. Below, there are swirling lines and a snake-like creature.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve in the Garden with Two Sheep and Two Doves
artworks.medium: cut paper pasted to red-painted wood, the figures and animals touched with graphite, pen and brush with gray and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This painting depicts an elaborate design with abstract floral patterns and mythical creatures on a rich red background. The central focus is on two intertwined figures resembling mythological beings, surrounded by a complex pattern of swirling lines that resemble vines or branches. A symmetrical circular motif is at the top, with smaller circular shapes around it. The composition includes fantastical creatures like a horned, goat-like animal and small winged creatures. The painting features floral and celestial motifs, adding to its tapestry-like feel. The style is reminiscent of medieval manuscript illumination or early Renaissance works, known for detailed decorative patterns and mystical themes.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve in the Garden with a Pair of Sheep and a Pair of Doves
artworks.medium: cut paper pasted to a red-painted and varnished paper, laid down on wood, the figures and animals drawn over with graphite, pen and gray ink, and touches of red paint, plus green and brown watercolor in the doves
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of two figures in front of an ornate patterned background. The central content shows two intertwined, nude figures against a red backdrop with golden vine-like patterns. There is a bird flying in the upper right corner and two sheep in the lower right corner. The style resembles detailed works from the early Renaissance or late Gothic period, with rich patterning and allegorical subjects. The composition combines classical beauty and intricate decorative elements.

artworks.title: Marie Louise Petit at the Age of 105, with Her Young Nurse
artworks.medium: watercolor over black and red chalk, heightened with white chalk on cream laid paper (cut across the top and reattached), laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips in Memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman sitting in a wooden chair, with her hands resting on her lap holding a cloth object. She wears a blue gown with long sleeves and a white collar, a white bonnet covering most of her hair. Another figure, a woman, stands beside her wearing a long dark dress with a white apron, and her head partially obscured by a large white headdress. The background shows a simple room with a flat-toned wall and a wooden floor.

artworks.title: Interior of South Taku Fort Showing the Place of Landing, June 25, 1859
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This image captures a sweeping view from an elevated position overlooking a landscape. On the left, several small, arch-roofed structures are arranged in rows, suggesting a camp or settlement. On the right, multiple irrigation channels or trenches meander through the flat terrain. The horizon is visible high in the composition, with flat lands merging into the sky. The color palette is muted sepia, giving the photo an aged or historical look. The sky is minimally visible at the top, highlighting the vast land and man-made patterns.

artworks.title: Interior of the Second North Fort After Its Surrender on August 21, 1860, Wherein 2000 Prisoners Were Taken
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historical scene of a military fortification from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the image showing a barren area with earthen mounds and structures. Two large embankments dominate the composition, one on the left with domed shelters. Wooden logs and supplies lean against the slopes. More earthwork structures extend into the distance leading to a line of fortifications across the horizon. A muddy pathway runs diagonally towards the right, flanked by trenches or excavation lines. The color palette is muted with earth tones like browns and greys, giving an aged look.

artworks.title: Interior of Pehtang Fort Showing Probyn's Horse, August 1, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view overlooking a sprawling landscape with a large encampment or military camp. The horizon is high in the image, displaying a vast expanse of land. The horizon features a structured arrangement of tents and makeshift constructions surrounding a fortified area that appears to be a walled settlement or fort on the left side. The color palette is sepia, emphasizing the details in the terrain and the tents. Figures and horses can be seen amidst the tents, depicting a scene of activity. The lines of tents and paths lead the eye towards the distance, where the camp extends into the horizon.

artworks.title: Tangkoo Fort After Its Capture, Showing the French and English Entrance, August 10, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows earth embankments and a water-filled trench from a low angle. A structure with battlements runs along the horizon, interrupted by a gate and a distant building. Two figures sit on either side of the trench. The image has a sepia tone with shades of beige and brown dominating the color palette.

artworks.title: Head Quarter House, First Division, Pehtang, China
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of sculptures arranged within an ornate setting. The wooden table in the foreground is adorned with various objects. The subjects of the sculptures are various figures. The central figures are two larger-than-life statues seated behind the table. They are flanked on either side by smaller, more intricately detailed sculptures. The sculpture on the left holds a paper or document, while the one on the right is poised with a staff or tool. The figures are crafted from a material that appears aged, possibly wood or stone, with a dark, earthy color patina. The details suggest clothing with ornate patterns and textures. The setting includes lattice screens on either side. Overall, the sculptures collectively present a tableau reflecting cultural or traditional motifs evident in their attire and posture.

artworks.title: Exterior of North Taku Fort on Peiho River, Showing the English and French Entrance, August 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a weathered fortification in the distance. A muddy terrain and water body are in the foreground, reflecting the fort's structure and the sky. The fort has visible damage with breaches in its walls. A person sits in a boat on the water to the right. The color palette is sepia tones.

artworks.title: Exterior of North Fort Showing the English Entrance, August 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a dilapidated structure, possibly a fort or building. The structure stretches horizontally across the scene, with the horizon defined by the tops of the crumbling walls and scattered debris. A small body of water is in the foreground, reflecting the posts and other elements from the bank. A wooden bridge spans the water, leading towards a path that angles into the distance. Branches or sticks are scattered near the bank, and upright stakes line a section of the area. The color palette is muted, with earthy tones dominating the scene. The texture is smooth and there are no visible brushstrokes since this is a photograph. The coloration and contrasts are subdued, capturing the historical and worn atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Angle of North Taku Fort at Which the French Entered, August 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a decaying adobe structure viewed from ground level. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dominant wall running horizontally across the image. The wall tilts slightly backward as it extends into the distance. The top of the wall is uneven, with some areas crumbling and supported by wooden ladders. Spiky wooden stakes are placed in the ground, forming a line in the lower part of the image. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia, giving the scene a vintage quality. The background sky is a pale tone, contrasting with the rugged texture of the wall and ground in the foreground.

artworks.title: Rear of the North Fort After Its Capture, Showing the Retreat of the Chinese Army, August 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a wide landscape with a fortress on the horizon. The fortress has solid walls with openings and flags flying on top. The foreground is barren with patches of mud, water pools, and some figures scattered around. The horizon is in the upper third of the image. The color palette is sepia-toned. The image appears to be a photograph.

artworks.title: Interior of the North Fort Taku After Its Capture on August 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image displays a desolate landscape with trenches and fortifications. The horizon is high in the image, showing an open sky and distant structures. The foreground has earthworks, scattered debris, and rudimentary shelters. The photo is in sepia tone, giving it an aged feel. It has a wide-angle perspective and no active human presence.

artworks.title: Top of the Wall From Anting Gate, Pekin, Taken Possession by English and French Troops, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view looking down along a fortified wall that extends into the distance, disappearing near the horizon. The horizon is positioned high in the composition, with the wall dominating the scene. On the right side of the wall, there are towering poles, while to the left, rows of traditional-style buildings align parallel with the wall, creating a street-like appearance. The wall, structures, and open land feature a desaturated, vintage color palette of sepia tones. The scene includes areas touched by diffused sunlight and shadows cast by the wall and surrounding architecture. In the background, a mix of natural and architectural elements continues with no distinct features breaking the flat horizon, depicting an expansive landscape.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Winter Palace, Pekin, October 29, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a large traditional building on the right side of the frame. The horizon is low in the image, with a line of trees and a long, low wall. Two tall, ornate columns are on the left, each crowned with decorative finials. Close to us is a grassy area leading to a paved section bordered by a stone balustrade. The middle of the image is dominated by the building's textured wall and intricate architectural details of its upper levels. The color palette is a monochrome sepia tone.

artworks.title: View of the Imperial Winter Palace, Pekin, Showing the Artificial Hill, October 29, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of a traditional Asian architectural landscape from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is lined with buildings featuring pagoda-style roofs. The scene includes a complex of structures, possibly a palace or temple area, and a dense array of foliage and trees in the foreground. Various pavilions and pagodas are scattered throughout the landscape, with a hill rising to the left, topped by a larger pagoda. The photograph is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: The Great Pagoda in the Imperial Winter Palace, Pekin, October 29, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts a hillside with buildings and vegetation, including a central stupa or pagoda. The horizon is high in the composition, with the hill occupying much of the frame against the sky. Several traditional buildings are scattered around the main structure among trees. The foreground shows flat, textured terrain. The color palette is muted sepia, giving the image a vintage quality.
